name: MVGS_CS_RD_ACMG_STRENGTH
title: MV-GenomSeq ACMG evidence strength
description: Strength with which an ACMG/AMP evidence criterion was applied (KDK RareDiseasesMolecular *.acmgCriteria[].modifier), including the DNPM tier 'bm' (moderate benign). Value of a criterion component on MolGen diagnostische-implikation whose code is the ClinGen criterion (https://clinicalgenome.org/codesystem/acmg-criteria); interim until MolGen profiles ACMG criteria (DISCUSS-TD #30).

concept.definition: DNPM extension of the ACMG/AMP benign tiers.
